<style>

  :root{
    --paper: #F3EFE3;
    --paper-deep: #EAE4D3;
    --ink: #1C2A38;
    --ink-soft: #4C5A67;
    --ink-faint: #8992A0;
    --rule: #C9C0A6;
    --rule-strong: #A79A78;
    --brass: #A5732B;
    --brass-deep: #7E5A22;
    --white: #FBFAF6;
    --max: 920px;
  }

  *{ box-sizing: border-box; }

  html{ scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body{
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--paper);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  h1, h2, h3, .serif{
    font-family: 'Spectral', serif;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--ink);
    margin: 0;
  }

  a{ color: inherit; }

  .wrap{
    max-width: var(--max);
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 28px;
  }

  /* ---------- Letterhead ---------- */

  .letterhead{
    border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
    padding: 22px 0;
  }

  .letterhead .wrap{
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px 24px;
  }

  .letterhead .name{
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }

  .letterhead .contact{
    font-size: 0.86rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .letterhead .contact > *{
    margin-right: 18px;
  }

  .letterhead .contact > *:last-child{
    margin-right: 0;
  }

  .letterhead .contact a{ text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; }
  .letterhead .contact a:hover{ border-bottom-color: var(--ink-soft); }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */

  .hero{
    padding: 76px 0 64px;
  }

  .hero .role-line{
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--brass-deep);
    font-family: 'Spectral', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .hero h1{
    font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 4.6vw, 3.4rem);
    line-height: 1.14;
    max-width: 15ch;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .hero .sub{
    margin-top: 24px;
    max-width: 54ch;
    font-size: 1.06rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .hero .cta-row{
    margin-top: 34px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .hero-grid{
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 56px;
  }

  .hero-text{ flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }

  .portrait{
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 178px;
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .portrait .frame{
    background: transparent;
  }

  .portrait img{
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    object-fit: cover;
    filter: grayscale(18%) contrast(1.02);
  }

  .portrait .cap{
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--ink-faint);
    text-align: center;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  @media (max-width: 720px){
    .hero-grid{ flex-direction: column-reverse; gap: 28px; align-items: flex-start; }
    .portrait{ width: 116px; }
  }

  .btn{
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 12px 22px;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
  }

  .btn.primary{ background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
  .btn.primary:hover{ background: var(--brass-deep); border-color: var(--brass-deep); }
  .btn.ghost{ background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
  .btn.ghost:hover{ background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }

  @keyframes rise{
    from{ opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
    to{ opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .hero.play .role-line{ animation: rise 0.6s ease 0.05s forwards; }
  .hero.play h1{ animation: rise 0.7s ease 0.18s forwards; }
  .hero.play .sub{ animation: rise 0.6s ease 0.38s forwards; }
  .hero.play .cta-row{ animation: rise 0.6s ease 0.54s forwards; }
  .hero.play .portrait{ animation: rise 0.7s ease 0.22s forwards; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .hero .role-line, .hero h1, .hero .sub, .hero .cta-row, .hero .portrait{ opacity: 1; animation: none !important; }
  }

  /* ---------- Section shell ---------- */

  section{ padding: 56px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }

  .section-head{
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 34px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .section-head h2{
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }

  .section-head .note{
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--ink-faint);
    font-style: italic;
    font-family: 'Spectral', serif;
  }

  /* ---------- Ledger (track record) ---------- */

  .ledger{
    border-top: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
    border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
  }

  .ledger-row{
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: baseline;
    padding: 16px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    gap: 20px;
  }

  .ledger-row:last-child{ border-bottom: none; }

  .ledger-row .desc{
    font-size: 1rem;
    max-width: 46ch;
  }

  .ledger-row .desc .context{

    font-size: 0.82rem;

    margin-top: 3px;

<script>
  // Hero entrance is handled purely by CSS (.play class already present on load).

  // Count-up animation for the ledger figures, triggered once when scrolled into view.
  const figures = document.querySelectorAll('.figure[data-count]');
  const prefersReduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  function animateFigure(el){
    const target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-count'), 10);
    const suffix = el.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
    if(prefersReduced){
      el.textContent = target + suffix;
      return;
    }
    const duration = 900;
    const start = performance.now();
    function tick(now){
      const p = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      const val = Math.round(target * eased);
      el.textContent = val + suffix;
      if(p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if(entry.isIntersecting){
          animateFigure(entry.target);
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.5 });
    figures.forEach(f => io.observe(f));
  } else {
    figures.forEach(f => animateFigure(f));
  }
</script>
